# Underwriting Memo

**Risk summary**

Kelridge Office Partners owns and leases three Class A office buildings in Charlotte, NC to professional tenants. Total insured value is $22.7M across three locations. All buildings are fully sprinklered with monitored alarms. The insured operates under governing class OFFC (Office / lessors risk). Submission received through Halvane Risk Partners, a top-tier broker, with a fit score of 99.2.

**Appetite and referral**

This risk is **IN** appetite per **AG-002** (Office / lessors risk is a target class, up to $40M TIV per account). The account falls well within our TIV limit at $22.7M. Territory is acceptable per **AG-014** (Southeast inland locations are in appetite). No referral items identified.

**Loss history**

Five-year loss history with Arbelle Mutual shows excellent performance. Only one claim in 2023: a water damage incident with $6,400 incurred and paid, now closed. All other years are loss-free. This favorable loss history aligns with **AG-002** preference criteria.

**Exposure and concentration**

All three locations are in Charlotte, creating geographic concentration. Portfolio TIV within 25km is $43.92M. All locations are inland (248-253km from coast), eliminating coastal windstorm exposure.

**Recommendation**

Recommend proceeding to quote. Strong appetite fit, excellent loss history, superior protection features, and top-tier broker relationship support favorable terms.
